import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.LocallyFree
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LocallyFreeOfRank
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SheafOverEquivalence

/-!
# Quasi-coherence of rank-indexed locally free sheaves

The project-local `IsLocallyFreeOfRank` predicate records a trivialisation on
an open cover.  This file connects that predicate to Mathlib's
`SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent` property.  The only transport needed on a
chart is the modules-level open-subscheme/over-slice equivalence.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace SheafOfModules

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- A locally free sheaf of a fixed finite rank is quasi-coherent.

On each trivialising open, `mapFreeIso` transports the finite free model
through the open-subscheme/over-slice equivalence; the resulting isomorphism
gives a presentation with the empty relation family.  These local
presentations are assembled by `IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop`.
-/
theorem IsLocallyFreeOfRank.isQuasicoherent {M : X.Modules} {d : ℕ}
    (hM : IsLocallyFreeOfRank M d) : M.IsQuasicoherent := by
  obtain ⟨I, U, hUtop, hUiso⟩ := hM
  let chartPresentation : ∀ i, (M.over (U i)).Presentation := fun i => by
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.overEquivalence (U i)).functor
    let eRestrict : M.restrict (U i).ι ≅
        SheafOfModules.free (R := (U i : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
          (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) :=
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (U i).ι).app M ≪≫ (hUiso i).some
    let eFree :
        SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))
            (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) ≅ M.over (U i) :=
      (SheafOfModules.mapFreeIso F (ULift.{u} (Fin d))
          (Scheme.Modules.unitOverIso (U i)).symm ≪≫
        F.mapIso eRestrict.symm ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictOverIso (U i) M)
    let gens : (M.over (U i)).GeneratingSections :=
      { I := ULift.{u} (Fin d)
        s := (M.over (U i)).freeHomEquiv eFree.hom
        epi := by
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
          infer_instance }
    let rels : (Limits.kernel gens.π).GeneratingSections :=
      { I := PEmpty.{u + 1}
        s := PEmpty.elim
        epi := by
          haveI : IsIso gens.π := by
            change IsIso ((M.over (U i)).freeHomEquiv.symm
              ((M.over (U i)).freeHomEquiv eFree.hom))
            rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
            infer_instance
          have hz : Limits.IsZero (Limits.kernel gens.π) :=
            Limits.isZero_kernel_of_mono _
          exact ⟨fun g h _ => hz.eq_of_src g h⟩ }
    exact { generators := gens, relations := rels }
  let q : M.QuasicoherentData :=
    { I := I
      X := U
      coversTop := by
        intro W x hxW
        have hx : x ∈ iSup U := by rw [hUtop]; trivial
        rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hx
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
        exact ⟨U i ⊓ W, homOfLE inf_le_right,
          ⟨i, ⟨homOfLE inf_le_left⟩⟩, hi, hxW⟩
      presentation := chartPresentation }
  exact q.isQuasicoherent

end SheafOfModules

end AlgebraicGeometry
